scenes.name: mares
scenes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one ORIGINAL 3:4 portrait full-bleed background asset for the coastal medieval fantasy town Mares in a 240x320 handheld RPG. Match the nostalgic richly detailed jewel-colored SNES/16-bit pixel-art town style of the Carvalho game reference visible in this conversation: intricate warm timber buildings, readable tiny-scale silhouettes, rich navy shadows and golden sunlight. This image is ONLY background artwork, absolutely NO text, letters, signs with lettering, UI, buttons, frames, title plaques, icons, border, device, mockup or watermark.
Mares has a distinct identity as a harbor town importing weapons: turquoise sea, sandstone harbor walls, tiled merchant houses, wooden pier, moored sailing vessel with cream sails, coiled ropes and a small coastal market. Bright clear maritime daylight, teal sea and coral-orange roofs. View from cobbled quayside toward the water, inhabited and welcoming, no large foreground people. Important silhouette: a cream-sailed ship and harbor arch visible in the middle band between 35 and 55 percent of image height, framed by detailed buildings on left and right. Top quarter has blue sky, roofs and distant lighthouse, bottom half has weathered cobblestone and ropes, not empty flat color. Composition must still read at240x320; larger clustered pixels and distinct broad forms, avoid painterly blur. Future code will overlay controls in lower45% and small header above, but do not draw those controls. Town stays a continuous scenic illustration. Output one portrait3:4 image.
